describes: Rows of the Cloud Billing standard usage cost export table exported from BigQuery as newline-delimited JSON (the export format that keeps the nested credits array).

sources.covers: field names service.description, sku.description, usage_start_time/usage_end_time (TIMESTAMP), project.id, cost (FLOAT), currency, usage.amount, usage.unit, cost_type values, credits[] (name, amount, type)

unverified: textual form of TIMESTAMP values in the NDJSON export (accepted: RFC 3339 with zone, or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS UTC'; anything else is rejected)
SKU description wording for model and token direction
cost and credits[].amount are FLOAT64: treated as 15 significant digits
provenance.notes: Each credits[] element becomes its own credit line. Same scope and category rules as gemini_billing_export_csv.

timestamps.note: BigQuery TIMESTAMP values are UTC and are written with a zone marker.
